summary: Highway Holdings Limited filed a Form 6-K attaching its July 20, 2026 press release reporting Q1 fiscal 2027 financial results. Revenue rose 29.2% to $2 million, gross profit increased 58.4% to $835,000, gross margin expanded to approximately 42%, and the company returned to operating profitability of $59,000 from a $138,000 loss. Net income attributable to shareholders was $109,000, or $0.02 per diluted share. Management discussed strategic discussions with potential partners for product-focused transitions, but no definitive transactions were announced. This is a routine earnings release, not a special situation; what to watch is continued turnaround execution.
